programs.description: After Shridhar Pant's business partner backstabs him, he is devastated. However, his life changes when he meets three criminals who plan on helping him.
A man gets his son transferred to another school in hopes of giving him a good future. However, the young boy faces difficulty in coping with the changes that the new learning environment brings.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.

A couple turns murderers out of greed and uses pretence and lies to enter a wealthy family. Years later, their youngest daughter-in-law learns about their past crimes and plans to teach them a lesson.
Sulbatai returns to India after earning belittlement from her daughter-in-law for her demeanour. So, when her son requests her to return to the USA, she strives to prove her worth.
The lives of two bachelors change when they find an abandoned baby boy outside their house and are forced to take care of him. Inexperienced, the duo face a lot of difficulties raising him.
As a group of boys set out to face college and its reality, their interpersonal relationships and mischief bring up unforeseen challenges.
